# Remove obsolete preparation steps when deleting an empty test helper

Proposed documentation follow-up in FolderDisplayHelpers: update the display-completion comment that still refers to step #2 and resetting messageLoaded after plan_for_message_display was removed. Keep instructions tied to the current awaitable helper rather than a deleted no-op. This is a scoped manual documentation rule, not a formatter rule or a required new helper abstraction. The source was inspected without running affected tests. Complete Bugzilla and historical Phabricator timeline/inline discussion remains pending.

Scope: mail / test.
